title: Grey-block to video
description: Turn a grey-block or previs clip into a finished shot: the camera and motion stay, the grey shapes become your character, vehicle and place. Runs MiniMax H3 on this computer.

controls.label: Direction
controls.default:
subject_definitions
<Video 1> = a grey-block previsualisation clip: untextured grey shapes that stand for the people, vehicles and places of the shot. <Picture 1> = the main character. <Picture 2> = a vehicle or prop. <Picture 3> = the location.
summary
Turn <Video 1> into a finished live-action film shot. Keep the camera move, framing, timing, motion and blocking of <Video 1> exactly. Every grey shape becomes the real thing it stands for: the grey figure becomes the person in <Picture 1> with the same face, hair and clothes; the grey vehicle or prop becomes the one in <Picture 2>; the grey surroundings become the place in <Picture 3>.
retention_analysis
Preserve from <Video 1>: camera path, lens feel, framing, every movement and its timing, the position and scale of every object. Replace: all grey untextured surfaces with real materials, light and detail.
detailed_description
Photoreal, cinematic natural light, real textures, believable shadows and reflections, slight film grain.
overall_soundscape
Natural sound of the scene: engine, wind, traffic or ambience that fits the action.
non_diegetic_music
N/A

evidence: 2026-10-31: H3 reference-to-video core of the Comfy hub workflow https://comfy.org/hub/workflows/minimax-h3-video-restyling-58a3f7167dba/ (API graph decoded from the page). Removed: Gemini Nano Banana key art, OpenRouter prompt writers, OpenAI image, ElevenLabs voice, IfElse, VHS nodes. Added: core LoadVideo/GetVideoComponents, three LoadImage references on the node's ref_images sockets (2 optional), the official ref2v 4-step turbo LoRA (as in the official multiframe template, steps 20 -> 4), CreateVideo/SaveVideo, and a fixed structured prompt in the six-section format the hub's prompt writer produces.
2026-10-31: Fast/Quality switch added the way the official H3 templates switch turbo: PrimitiveBoolean -> ComfySwitchNode for the model (turbo LoRA or base) and the steps (4 or 20).

2026-10-31: Sharpen 2x added after the LBH-123-AI example workflow (latent upscale, then 3 refine steps from sigma 0.9035 with the turbo model), using the native MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleWithModel node; a ComfySwitchNode picks the draft or the sharpened latent, so the refine branch only runs when switched on.

2026-11-02: Added a fourth optional image input to the existing H3 reference node. Graph compilation is tested; multi-person replacement, identity matching and scene preservation are not qualified by a render.

2026-11-02: Optional source audio uses ComfyUI core EmptyAudio, AudioConcat and TrimAudioDuration at generated frame count / 24 fps. It pads short or absent source audio with silence. Node contracts and graph compilation were checked, but no end-to-end source-audio render has been verified. Generated audio remains the default.
